findings.finding: After a terminal settlement marks a record inactive, asyncNotice fallback can still select that same record when its work equals current processing.work_id. Existing failure=budget or failed state can therefore remain visible as a live blocker after authoritative settlement, even while the new tick is allowed. This conflicts with truthful progress status.
findings.requested_change: Exclude inactive or terminal-settled records from the fallback; keep pending old records visible and preserve all blocking/dispatch conditions.

findings.finding: Opening publication fallback joins a committed publication/outbox by same session and matching body hash, but does not bind publication/outbox event_id to the qualified work.event_id. Two same-body historical messages could borrow the publication evidence of a different event. Terminal settlement contract requires the exact work publication, not equivalent prose.
findings.requested_change: Bind both committed publication and published outbox to the exact qualified work event (and existing expected step/control/authority fields as appropriate); preserve real opening compatibility and no-body output.
